description: A connected system proposes a change to a CallPilotAI record. IT CHANGES NOTHING. The proposal is stored for a human to decide, because CallPilotAI is the leading system and a second system that may write is a second leading system. A newer proposal for the same field from the same source replaces the older one as long as nobody has decided — otherwise ten proposals for one phone number pile up and nobody knows which is current. This is the tool a connected system calls INSTEAD of update_contact.

entity.description: Table of the CallPilotAI record the change is proposed for, e.g. contacts

source_ref.description: The id over there, so the proposal can be traced back.

name: suggest_change
